content: Better Sol: Develop Solana applications end-to-end using TypeScript | Product Hunt Launching today Better Sol Launching today Develop Solana applications end-to-end using TypeScript 9 followers Develop Solana applications end-to-end using TypeScript 9 followers Visit website Crypto tools Better Sol lets you write Solana programs entirely in TypeScript with zero boilerplate. One file defines your program and automatically becomes a fully typed client, so there's no IDL, no code generation, and nothing to keep in sync. Deploy with a single command, get autocomplete for every instruction and account field, built-in token operations, and composable transactions out of the box. No language switching, no manual codec, no local toolchain setup. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Launch tags: Open Source • GitHub • Web3 Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 9 Day Rank Upvote • 56 points Follow Better Sol Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info better-sol.fun Better Sol Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/better-sol Similar Products thirdweb Build web3 apps and games, easily 4.9 ( 10 reviews ) Web3 Crypto tools Quicknode The blockchain development platform 4.9 ( 44 reviews ) Web3 Crypto tools ChainGPT Unleash the power of Blockchain AI with ChainGPT 4.6 ( 27 reviews ) AI Chatbots Crypto tools Galxe Onboarding the world to Web3 4.9 ( 292 reviews ) Social & Community Web3 Ethereum The second-largest cryptocurrency platform 5.0 ( 11 reviews ) Defi Crypto exchanges View more Subscribe Sign in AssemblyAI Voice Agent API — One API to build production-ready voice agents One API to build production-ready voice agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment pow flins Maker 📌 Hey everyone! 👋 We built Better Sol because we were tired of the constant context switching when building on Solana. Write a program, generate an IDL, build a client, keep them in sync, repeat every time something changes. It felt wrong. So we made it so you only write TypeScript. One file defines your program, and that same file gives you a fully typed client with autocomplete, account fetching, token operations, and composable transactions. No IDL, no codegen, no sync headaches. We're still early and would love your feedback. If you build on Solana, try it out and let us know what hurts. We're here all day to answer questions. title: Keel
summary: An AI assistant whose memory belongs to you
content: Keel: An AI assistant whose memory belongs to you | Product Hunt Launching today Keel Launching today An AI assistant whose memory belongs to you 123 followers An AI assistant whose memory belongs to you 123 followers Visit website Note and writing apps Keel is a local-first desktop app for macOS and Windows that captures what matters from your conversations into plain markdown files on your disk. Bring your own model - Claude, GPT, OpenRouter, or Ollama. Your context stays with you, not the vendor. Open source, MIT. https://keel-labs.github.io/ Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team More Free Launch tags: Artificial Intelligence • GitHub • Virtual Assistants Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 7 Day Rank Upvote • 116 points Follow Keel Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info keel-labs.github.io GitHub Keel Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/keel-3 Similar Products Obsidian A versatile writing app tailored to your thinking 4.9 ( 161 reviews ) Note and writing apps Reflect Fast networked note-taking 4.8 ( 45 reviews ) Productivity Note and writing apps Logseq A privacy-first, open-source knowledge base 4.9 ( 64 reviews ) Note and writing apps Knowledge base software HyNote AI Full Stack AI Note Taker For Professionals 4.8 ( 37 reviews ) Note and writing apps AI notetakers Capacities A studio for your mind 4.8 ( 66 reviews ) Note and writing apps Team collaboration software View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Lightfield — AI-native CRM that builds itself and does work for you AI-native CRM that builds itself and does work for you Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Medha Ghatikesh Hunter 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I built Keel because every AI tool I tried had the same problem: my context lived inside someone else's product. The notes, the history, the slowly-built understanding of my projects - all trapped behind one vendor's login. The day that model gets deprecated or that company changes direction, my brain goes with it. Keel flips that. Your memories live on your disk, in plain markdown, in a folder you own. You can open them in any editor, back them up, version-control them, move them between machines. The model is the part that's interchangeable - Claude today, GPT tomorrow, a local Llama on a flight. The assistant changes; your context doesn't. A few things worth knowing: It's a real desktop app for Mac and Windows (Electron + React + TypeScript). Bring your own API key. No telemetry. No account. No cloud sync (yet). It's a v1 beta - Apple Silicon only, no Windows/Linux yet, no mobile. It's a one-person project. I'll read every comment here today; I can't promise to build every feature (yet). Would love your feedback. Thanks for taking a look. Upvote (2) Report Share 10d ago Francesco Bianchi @medhaforcebewithyou congrats for the launch l 🚀 As a user, where can I actually see what the assistant remembers about me, and can I delete things if I want to? Upvote Report Share 21h ago Medha Ghatikesh Hunt
